headline: Real Madrid best Barça in brilliant Clásico; Man United mess deepens; Spurs win again
description: The weekend's big games brought plenty to unpack, with Real Madrid's Clásico win slowing Barcelona down in LaLiga and Man United's heavy home defeat surely pushing Michael Carrick toward the exit.

headline: Chelsea will 'keep confidence' in Mike Penders - Xabi Alonso
description: Xabi Alonso and Maxence Lacroix have thrown their support behind Mike Penders after the 21-year-old's own goal led to Saturday's 2-0 loss to Tottenham.

headline: Gary Neville: Some Man United players 'aren't that professional'
description: Gary Neville has launched a scathing tirade at Manchester United's players following their latest heavy defeat.

headline: New England No.1? James Trafford tipped by Leeds boss
description: Daniel Farke praised James Trafford's potential following a solid display in Leeds' 0-0 draw against Sunderland.

headline: Who could replace Carrick after Man United's worst start since 1986?
description: Manchester United have struggled this season, but which managers could step in to replace Michael Carrick if the club sacks him?

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United eye Branthwaite amid defensive rebuild
description: Manchester United are plotting a huge defensive rebuild, with Everton center back Jarrad Branthwaite at the center of their plans. Transfer Talk has the latest.
